narration: Synthetic voice added with Microsoft Edge TTS
editing: An actual screenshot introduces the problem. Recorded recovery movements are slowed for narration. The final segment shows an actual completed Vultr containment test. No additional model recovery was run.

scenes.name: problem
scenes.text: Rewind helps you fix damaged database values without losing newer work. Here, a bad import multiplied one hundred twenty invoice prices by one hundred. These invoices are fictional.

scenes.name: selection
scenes.text: I choose only the damaged prices. Rewind shows each current price beside its value in the good backup.

scenes.name: plan
scenes.text: Restoring the whole backup would lose seven new invoices and reset twenty payment updates. This plan keeps those changes and restores only the prices.

scenes.name: recovery
scenes.text: Vultr AI writes the recovery program. It runs on copies in an isolated container. A separate checker reads the result and compares every value.

scenes.name: result
scenes.text: The one hundred twenty prices are fixed. All one hundred twenty seven invoices remain, including seven newer invoices and twenty payment updates.

scenes.name: checks
scenes.text: All checks passed. Five isolated runs finished, and every temporary container was removed. The checked database is ready to download.

scenes.name: download
scenes.text: I download the recovery copy and its checks. Rewind restores the damaged prices and keeps today's work.

scenes.name: containment-test
scenes.text: Here is a separate containment test. This fixed program tries to run forever. The Vultr sandbox stops it at the two second limit and removes the container.
